title: Mobile money journeys: Maestro E2E (backlog A2)

acceptance_criteria.outcome: Native flows drive mobile personal expense edit and delete, move to group, group expense edit and delete, an exact group split, recurring run-now and edit, and settle-up on iOS and Android, each checking stored data through the API.
A web test resets a password from a link and signs out all devices with an account of its own, keeping the account suite within 5 logins a minute.
The reset-token helper refuses any database other than the local trackspense_qa database and any non-QA address.

implementation_approval.reference: User message 2026-11-27: 'I confirm AC-005 to AC-010. I approve the TS-QA-106 plan. Fix the AC-011 problem in receipt, split and payer fields, and fix recurring amounts too.', replying to a summary of this plan's scope. It does not state that the native suites passed, and authorizes no merge or release.

notes: Record written after the build (2026-11-27). Raised from standard to high: it touches a CI workflow file (comment only) and a password-reset token script. The owner approved the plan after the build (see implementation_approval).
